verdict.rationale: Muse's docs explicitly describe goal/event-driven automation: once a goal is set, 'Muse continues to work on a schedule and in response to relevant events, taking the next step and following up' and it 'monitors, follows up, and sends a notification when something needs your attention.' This matches the story of defining triggers/rules that fire actions automatically. missing for 10: no detail on how granular/customizable the rule definitions are (e.g., explicit conditional logic beyond goals), and no independent/hands-on verification of this automation working reliably in practice.
